translations.idiomatic: High officials' cases required prior imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 如取諸色官狀，即申中書取裁。

translations.literal: If taking various office statements, then report to the Secretariat for decision."
translations.idiomatic: Lower ranks went to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Assented.
translations.idiomatic: Assented.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，前淮南節度使、金紫光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射、兼揚州大都督府長史、御史大夫、上柱國、贊皇郡開國公、食邑一千五百戶李玨卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingchen: former Huainan commissioner, Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Left Vice Director, concurrent Yangzhou metropolitan prefect and Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Duke of Zanhuang with fifteen hundred households Li Jue died — posthumously Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue died and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 敕犯贓人平贓，據律以當時物價上旬估。

translations.literal: Edict: for graft cases restitution — per law use the first ten-day price estimate of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Restitution was to use local ten-day price tables.

sentences.zh: 請取所犯之處，其月內上旬時估平之。

translations.literal: Take the place of the offense, the first ten-day estimate of that month to balance accounts.
translations.idiomatic: The local month's early estimate governed restitution.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict; the throne assented.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 檢校司空、太子少師、上柱國、范陽郡開國公、食邑二千戶盧鈞可太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: Acting Minister of Works, heir-apparent Junior Preceptor, Pillar of State, Duke of Fanyang with two thousand households Lu Jun was Taiyuan prefect, northern capital regent, and Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jun took Taiyuan and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 九月，敕起居郎轉官月限，宜以二十個月。

translations.literal: Ninth month: edict — Palace Attendant transfer month limit should be twenty months.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendants now rotated every twenty months.

sentences.zh: 大中七年七年春正月壬辰，金紫光祿大夫、守太子少傅分司、上柱國、晉陵郡開國公、食邑二千戶歸融卒，贈右僕射。

translations.literal: Dazhong 7, spring, first month, renchen: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting heir-apparent Junior Preceptor at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Duke of Jinling with two thousand households Gui Rong died — posthumously Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong died and was posthumously Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿李文會貶睦州刺史。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Li Wenhui was demoted to Mizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wenhui was demoted to Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 四月，以御史大夫鄭朗為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Censor-in-Chief Zheng Lang was Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Lang joined the council.

sentences.zh: 五月，左衛率府倉曹張戣集律令格式條件相類一千二百五十條，分一百二十一門，號曰《刑法統類》，上之。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Left Guard rate-house registrar Zhang Guai collected similar articles of statutes, regulations, and formats — one thousand two hundred fifty items in one hundred twenty-one categories, titled Comprehensive Categories of Penal Law, and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guai submitted another Comprehensive Categories of Penal Law.

sentences.zh: 七月，以正議大夫、尚書左丞、上柱國、賜金魚袋崔璪為刑部尚書，以銀青光祿大夫、行兵部侍郎、知制誥、充翰林學士蘇滌為尚書左丞，權知戶部侍郎崔璵可權知兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Regular Grand Master, Left Vice Director with gold fish Cui Can was Vice Minister of Punishments; Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of War, edict drafter, Hanlin academician Su Mi was Left Vice Director; acting Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Huan was acting Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Can, Su Mi, and Cui Huan exchanged high posts.

sentences.zh: 十月，尚書左僕射、門下侍郎、平章事、太清宮使、弘文館大學士崔鉉進《續會要》四十卷，修撰官楊紹復、崔瑑、薛逢、鄭言等，賜物有差。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Left Vice Director, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, Grand Pure Temple commissioner, Hongwen Hall academician Cui Xuan presented Continued Institutional Compendium forty scrolls — compilers Yang Shaofu, Cui Zuan, Xue Feng, Zheng Yan, and others — gifts graded.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuan presented forty scrolls of the Continued Institutional Compendium.

sentences.zh: 大中八年八年春正月，陝州黃河清。

translations.literal: Dazhong 8, spring, first month: the Yellow River cleared at Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River ran clear at Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，南蠻進犀牛，詔還之。

translations.literal: Second month: southern barbarians presented a rhinoceros — edict returned it.
translations.idiomatic: A rhinoceros tribute was sent back.

sentences.zh: 三月，敕以旱詔使疏決繋囚。

translations.literal: Third month: edict drought envoys to review imprisoned persons.
translations.idiomatic: Drought prompted review of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 宰相監修國史魏謩修成《文宗實錄》四十卷，上之，修史官給事中盧耽、太常少卿蔣偕、司勳員外郎王渢、右補闕盧吉，頒賜銀器、錦彩有差。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor and dynastic historian Wei Mo completed Veritable Record of Wenzong in forty scrolls and presented it — compilers Remonstrance official Lu Dan, Grand Master of Ceremonies Jiang Jie, Bureau of Merit outer-section member Wang Hong, Right Reminder Lu Ji — silver vessels and brocade gifts graded.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Mo presented forty scrolls of Wenzong's Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 以山南東道節度使、檢校戶部尚書、襄州刺史、上柱國、酒泉縣開國子、食邑三百戶李景讓為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Shannan East commissioner, acting Minister of Revenue, Xiangzhou prefect, Pillar of State, Viscount of Jiuquan with three hundred households Li Jingrang was Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingrang took Personnel.

sentences.zh: 五月，以中書舍人、翰林學士韋澳為京兆尹；

translations.literal: Fifth month: Secretariat Drafter and Hanlin academician Wei Ao was Jingzhao prefect;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ao became Jingzhao prefect;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎、翰林學士承旨、上柱國、武功縣開國子、食邑三百戶蘇滌檢校兵部尚書，兼江陵尹、御史大夫，充荊南節度管內觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue, Hanlin academician-director, Pillar of State, Viscount of Wugong with three hundred households Su Mi was acting Minister of War, concurrent Jiangling prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Jingnan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Su Mi took Jiangling and Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 七月，銀青光祿大夫、守門下侍郎、同平章事魏謩兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor Wei Mo was also Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Mo also took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月，以司農卿鄭助為檢校左散騎常侍，兼夏州刺史、御史大夫、上柱國、滎陽縣開國男、食邑三百戶、夏綏銀宥等州節度營田觀察處置押蕃落安撫平夏党項等使。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Minister of Agriculture Zheng Zhu was acting Left Cavalier, concurrent Xiazhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Baron of Xingyang with three hundred households, and Xia-Sui-Yin-You commissioner with frontier pacification duties.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhu took Xia and the northwest frontier.

sentences.zh: 大中九年九年春正月辛巳，銀青光祿大夫、秘書監、許昌縣開國男陳商卒，贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: Dazhong 9, spring, first month, xinsi: Silver-glitter Grand Master, Palace Library Director, Baron of Xuchang Chen Shang died — posthumously Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shang died and was posthumously Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，中書侍郎，兼禮部尚書、同平章事裴休檢校吏部尚書，兼汴州刺史、御史大夫，充宣武軍節度使、汴宋亳潁觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Second month: Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, Grand Councillor Pei Xiu was acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Bianzhou prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xiu took Bianzhou and Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 三月，試宏詞舉人，漏匯題目，為御史台所劾，侍郎裴諗改國子祭酒，郎中周敬復罰兩月俸料，考試官刑部郎中唐枝出為處州刺史，監察御史馮顓罰一月俸料。

translations.literal: Third month: Expanded-Phrases examination candidates leaked compiled topics — impeached by the Censorate; Vice Minister Pei Shen became director of education; Bureau Director Zhou Jingfu fined two months' salary; examiner Tang Zhi sent out as Chuzhou prefect; investigating censor Feng Zhuan fined one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: A leaked examination cost ten degrees and several posts.

sentences.zh: 其登科十人並落下。

translations.literal: The ten who passed were all struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: All ten passers were disqualified.

sentences.zh: 其吏部東銓委右丞盧懿權判。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel eastern selection was entrusted to Right Vice Director Lu Yi to judge.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi judged the eastern selection.

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎鄭涯檢校禮部尚書，兼定州刺史、御史大夫，充義武軍節度、易定州觀察處置、北平軍等使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Zheng Ya was acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Dingzhou prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Yiwu army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ya took Yiwu and Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 御史台據正月八日禮部貢院捉到明經黃續之、趙弘成、全質等三人偽造堂印、堂帖，兼黃續之偽著緋衫，將偽帖入貢院，令與舉人虞蒸、胡簡、黨贊等三人及第，許得錢一千六百貫文。

translations.literal: The Censorate, per the eighth-day first-month Rites examination yard seizure of Classicist degree candidates Huang Xuzhi, Zhao Hongcheng, Quan Zhi, and three others forging hall seals and hall posts — Huang also falsely wore scarlet robe and brought forged posts into the yard for candidates Yu Zheng, Hu Jian, and Dang Zan to pass, promised one thousand six hundred strings cash.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate exposed forged examination credentials sold for sixteen hundred strings.

sentences.zh: 據勘黃續之等罪款，具招造偽，所許錢未曾入手，便事敗。

translations.literal: On investigation Huang and others confessed forgery; the promised money never changed hands before exposure.
translations.idiomatic: The bribe never paid before the plot failed.

sentences.zh: 奉敕並准法處死。

translations.literal: By edict all were executed per law.
translations.idiomatic: All forgers were executed.

sentences.zh: 主司以自獲奸人，並放。

translations.literal: The chief examiners, for catching the villains themselves, were all released.
translations.idiomatic: Examiners were spared for exposing the fraud.

sentences.zh: 七月，以河東節度使、檢校司空、太原尹、北都留守、上柱國、范陽郡開國公、食邑三千戶盧鈞守尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Hedong commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Taiyuan prefect, northern capital regent, Pillar of State, Duke of Fanyang with three thousand households Lu Jun was acting Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jun became acting Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 八月，以門下侍郎、守尚書右僕射、監修國史、博陵縣開國伯、食邑一千戶崔鉉檢校司空、同平章事，兼揚州大都督府長史，充淮南節度副大使、知節度使事。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Vice Director of the Secretariat, acting Right Vice Director, dynastic historian, Baron of Boling with one thousand households Cui Xuan was acting Minister of Education, Grand Councillor, concurrent Yangzhou metropolitan prefect, and Huainan vice commissioner knowing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuan took Huainan with council rank.

sentences.zh: 宣宗宴餞，賦詩以賜之。

translations.literal: Xuanzong feasted and composed verse to bestow on him.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong feasted Cui Xuan and gave him a poem.

sentences.zh: 九月，昭義節度使、檢校禮部尚書，兼潞州大都督府長史、御史大夫、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋鄭涓檢校刑部尚書、太原尹、北都留守、御史大夫，充河東節度、管內觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Zhaoyi commissioner, acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Lu metropolitan prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State with purple-gold fish Zheng Juan was acting Vice Minister of Punishments, Taiyuan prefect, northern capital regent, and Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Juan was made acting Minister of Punishments, Taiyuan intendant, northern capital regent, and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以河南尹劉瑑檢校工部尚書、汴州刺史、兼御史大夫、充宣武軍節度、宋亳汴潁觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Henan prefect Liu Zuan was acting Minister of Works, Bianzhou prefect, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zuan took Bianzhou and Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人鄭顥為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Zheng Hao was Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hao became Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 大中十年十年春正月乙巳，以正議大夫、華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使、上柱國、隴西縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋李訥檢校左散騎常侍，兼越州刺史、御史大夫、浙江東道都團練觀察等使。

translations.literal: Dazhong 10, spring, first month, yisi: Regular Grand Master, Huazhou prefect, Tong Pass defense commissioner, Zhenguo army commander, Pillar of State, Baron of Longxi with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Li Na was acting Left Cavalier, concurrent Yuezhou prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Zhejiang East observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na was made acting Left Cavalier, Yue prefect, censor-in-chief, and Zhejiang East observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月，中書門下奏：「據禮部貢院見置科目，《開元禮》、《三禮》、《三傳》、《三史》、學究、道舉、明算、童子等九科，近年取人頗濫，曾無實藝可采，徒添入仕之門。

translations.literal: Third month: Secretariat memorialized: "Per the subjects now in the Rites examination yard — Kaiyuan Rites, Three Rites, Three Classics, Three Histories, Classicist, Daoist degree, Ming arithmetic, and Youth categories — nine subjects; in recent years selections are too loose, no real craft to harvest, only adding entry to office."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked to tighten nine examination subjects.

sentences.zh: 須議條疏，俾精事業。

translations.literal: Regulations must be discussed so careers are refined.
translations.idiomatic: Standards needed tightening.

sentences.zh: 臣已于延英面論，伏奉聖旨，將文字來者。

translations.literal: Your servants have already argued face-to-face at Yanying and received the sacred order to send writing.
translations.idiomatic: The matter had been argued at Yanying.

sentences.zh: 其前件九科，臣等商量，望起大中十年，權停三年，滿後，至時赴科試者，令有司據所舉人先進名，令中書舍人重覆問過。

translations.literal: For the nine subjects above, your servants discuss: from Dazhong 10 suspend three years; when candidates return, have offices report prior names and Secretariat drafters re-examine.
translations.idiomatic: Nine subjects were suspended for three years from Dazhong 10.

sentences.zh: 中有本業稍通，堪備朝廷顧問，即作等第進名，候敕處分。

translations.literal: Those with some mastery fit for court consultation — make grades and advance names, await edict.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled candidates could still be nominated by grade.

sentences.zh: 如有事業荒蕪，不合送名數者，考官即議朝責。

translations.literal: If careers are barren and unfit to send up, examiners should be rebuked at court.
translations.idiomatic: Weak nominees would bring examiner punishment.

sentences.zh: 其童子近日諸道所薦送者，多年齒已過，偽稱童子，考其所業，又是常流。

translations.literal: Youth candidates lately sent by circuits are often over age, falsely called youth, and their work is common run.
translations.idiomatic: "Youth" candidates were often overage frauds.

sentences.zh: 起今日後，望今天下州府薦送童子，並須實年十一、十二已下，仍須精熟一經，問皆全通，兼自能書寫者。

translations.literal: From today when circuits send youth they must be truly eleven or twelve, master one classic with full answers, and write themselves.
translations.idiomatic: True youth candidates had to be eleven or twelve and master one classic.

sentences.zh: 如違制條，本道長吏亦議懲法。

translations.literal: If violating regulations, the circuit chief administrator is also punished."
translations.idiomatic: Violations would punish circuit chiefs.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Assented.
translations.idiomatic: Assented.

sentences.zh: 四月癸丑，以刑部郎中盧搏為廬州刺史，以給事中、渤海郡開國公、食邑二千戶高少逸檢校禮部尚書、華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, guichou: Punishments Bureau Director Lu Bo was Luzhou prefect; Remonstrance official, Duke of Bohai with two thousand households Gao Shaoyi was acting Minister of Rites, Huazhou prefect, Tong Pass defense commissioner, and Zhenguo army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Bo and Gao Shaoyi took Luzhou and Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，以兵部郎中裴夷直為蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Bureau of War Director Pei Yizhi was Suzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yizhi became Suzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月，以兵部郎中裴夷直為蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Bureau of War Director Pei Yizhi was Suzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Again, Pei Yizhi was made Suzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 九月，以中書舍人杜審權知禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Secretariat Drafter Du Shenquan was acting Rites examination commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shenquan oversaw the Rites examinations.

sentences.zh: 十月，邠甯慶節度使、檢校禮部尚書、邠州刺史、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋諴為檢校兵部尚書、潞州大都府長史、御史大夫，充昭義節度副大使、知節度使、潞邢洺等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Binning-Qing commissioner, acting Minister of Rites, Binzhou prefect, Pillar of State with purple-gold fish Zhen was acting Minister of War, Lu metropolitan prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Zhaoyi vice commissioner, and Lu-Xing-Ming observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen took Zhaoyi and Lu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 桂管觀察使令狐定卒，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Guangxi observation commissioner Linghu Ding died — posthumously Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Ding died and was posthumously Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 大中十一年十一年春正月，以銀青光祿大夫、守吏部尚書、上柱國、酒泉縣開國男、食邑三百戶李景讓為御史大夫；

translations.literal: Dazhong 11, spring, first month: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Minister of Personnel, Pillar of State, Viscount of Jiuquan with three hundred households Li Jingrang was Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingrang became censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 以朝請大夫、守御史中丞，兼尚書右丞、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋夏侯孜為戶部侍郎、判戶部事；

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting chief investigating censor and concurrent Right Vice Director with purple-gold fish Xiahou Zi was Vice Minister of Revenue and acting revenue head;
translations.idiomatic: Xiahou Zi took Revenue;

sentences.zh: 以朝散大夫、守京兆尹、上柱國、扶風縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋韋澳檢校工部尚書、孟州刺史、御史大夫，充河陽三城節度、孟懷澤觀處置等使。

translations.literal: Palace Companion, acting Jingzhao prefect, Pillar of State, Baron of Fufeng with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Wei Ao was acting Minister of Works, Mengzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Heyang Three Cities commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ao took Heyang from the capital prefecture.

sentences.zh: 先是，車駕將幸華清宮，兩省官進狀論奏，詔曰：「朕以驪山近宮，真聖廟貌，未嘗修謁，自謂闕然。

translations.literal: Earlier the imperial carriage was about to visit Huaqing Palace; officials of both departments submitted memorials; edict: "We take Mount Li near the palace — the true sage's likeness — never yet visited; We ourselves feel the lack."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong deferred a Huaqing trip after memorials.

sentences.zh: 今屬陽和氣清，中外事簡，聽政之暇，或議一行。

translations.literal: "Now with yang harmony and clear air, inner and outer affairs simple, in leisure from hearing cases We may discuss one journey."
translations.idiomatic: He cited seasonal leisure for a possible visit.

sentences.zh: 蓋崇禮敬之心，非以逸遊為事。

translations.literal: "It raises respectful mind — not taking pleasure travel as the affair."
translations.idiomatic: The trip would be reverence, not pleasure.

sentences.zh: 雖申敕命，兼慮勞人。

translations.literal: "Though We issue orders, We also fear troubling people."
translations.idiomatic: He still feared burdening the people.

sentences.zh: 卿等職備禁闈，志勤奉上，援據前古，列狀上章，載陳懇到之詞，深睹盡忠之節。

translations.literal: "You hold posts in the forbidden precincts, will loyal to the throne, citing antiquity in memorials — We see your earnest words and deep loyal intent."
translations.idiomatic: He praised the officials' earnest memorials.

sentences.zh: 已允來請，所奏鹹知。

translations.literal: "We have granted your request — your memorials are all noted."
translations.idiomatic: The Huaqing journey was canceled.

sentences.zh: 」以劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事、管內觀察處置統押近界諸蠻及西山八國雲南安撫等使、特進、檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事、兼成都尹、上柱國、太原郡開國公、食邑二千戶白敏中以本官兼江陵尹，充荊南節度、管內觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: " Sword South West vice commissioner, frontier pacification commissioner, Special Advance, acting Minister of Education, Grand Councillor, concurrent Chengdu prefect, Pillar of State, Duke of Taiyuan with two thousand households Bai Minzhong was at present rank also Jiangling prefect and Jingnan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Minzhong added Jingnan to his Chengdu post.

sentences.zh: 二月，以夏綏銀宥節度使、通議大夫、檢校左散騎常侍、夏州刺史、御史大夫、上柱國、滎陽縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋鄭助為檢校工部尚書、邠州刺史，充邠甯慶節度、管內營田觀察處置，兼充慶州南路救援、鹽州及當道沿路鎮寨糧料等使；

translations.literal: Second month: Xia-Sui-Yin-You commissioner, General-of-Policy Grand Master, acting Left Cavalier, Xiazhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Baron of Xingyang with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Zheng Zhu was acting Minister of Works, Binzhou prefect, Binning-Qing commissioner with frontier farms and grain duties;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhu was made acting Minister of Works, Bin prefect, and Binning-Qing commissioner with frontier farms and grain duties;

sentences.zh: 以右金吾衛將軍田在賓校右散騎常侍，兼夏州刺史，代鄭助為夏、綏、銀、宥節度等使。

translations.literal: Right Gold Crow guard general Tian Zaibin was Right Cavalier and Xiazhou prefect, replacing Zheng Zhu as Xia-Sui-Yin-You commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Zaibin replaced Zheng Zhu on the northwest frontier.

sentences.zh: 以荊南節度使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校兵部尚書、兼江陵尹、御史大夫、上柱國、武功郡開國男、食邑三百戶蘇滌為太常卿。

translations.literal: Jingnan commissioner, Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Minister of War, concurrent Jiangling prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Viscount of Wugong with three hundred households Su Mi was Grand Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Su Mi became Grand Master of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫、守門下侍郎、兼戶部尚書、同平章事、監修國史、上柱國魏謩檢校戶部尚書、同平章事，兼成都尹，充劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事。

translations.literal: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, Grand Councillor, dynastic historian, Pillar of State Wei Mo was acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councillor, concurrent Chengdu prefect, and Sword South West vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Mo took Chengdu and Sword South West.

sentences.zh: 乙太中大夫、守工部尚書、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋崔慎由為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Acting Grand Master of the Palace, acting Minister of Works with purple-gold fish Cui Shenyou was Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shenyou joined the council.

sentences.zh: 以成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙觀察處置等使、起復雲麾將軍、守左金吾衛大將軍同正、檢校兵部尚書、鎮州大都督府長史王紹鼎為銀青光祿大夫、檢校尚書右僕射，餘官如故。

translations.literal: Chengd army commissioner, acting Minister of War, Zhenzhou metropolitan prefect Wang Shaoding was Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Right Vice Director, other posts unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoding was promoted to acting Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 以通議大夫、守中書門下侍郎、兼禮部尚書、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋鄭朗可監修國史。

translations.literal: General-of-Policy Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, Grand Councillor, Hall of Assembled Worthies academician with purple-gold fish Zheng Lang might oversee dynastic history.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Lang was named to oversee the Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 太中大夫、守工部尚書、同平章事、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋崔慎由可集賢院大學士。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Palace, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councillor, Pillar of State with purple-gold fish Cui Shenyou might be Hall of Assembled Worthies academician.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shenyou also took the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 三月，起復朝請大夫、深州刺史、御史大夫，兼成德軍節度判官王紹懿可檢校左散騎常侍、鎮府左司馬、知府事，充成德軍節度副使，兼充都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Third month: restored-from-mourning Regular Grand Master, Shenzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Chengd army judge Wang Shaoyi was acting Left Cavalier, Zhenfu Left Army Major, knowing prefectural affairs, Chengd vice commissioner, and overall army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoyi became Chengd vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以成德軍中軍兵馬使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校太子賓客、兼監察御史、上柱國王景胤可本官、深州刺史、本州團練守捉使。

translations.literal: Chengd central army commander, Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting heir-apparent Guest of Honor, concurrent investigating censor, Pillar of State Wang Jingyin was at present rank, Shenzhou prefect, and local defense commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingyin took Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 檢校左散騎常侍、右神武大交軍知軍事王紹孚可落起復，依前右神武大將軍。

translations.literal: Acting Left Cavalier, Right Divine Strategy great-intersection army commander Wang Shaofu might leave mourning restoration and resume Right Divine Strategy great general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaofu left mourning and returned to the Right Divine Strategy.

sentences.zh: 紹懿、紹孚，鎮州王紹鼎之弟也。

translations.literal: Shaoyi and Shaofu were younger brothers of Zhenzhou's Wang Shaoding.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoyi and Shaofu were Wang Shaoding's brothers.

sentences.zh: 景胤，紹鼎子也。

translations.literal: Jingyin was Shaoding's son.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyin was Wang Shaoding's son.

sentences.zh: 以朝請大夫、檢校刑部尚書、華州刺史、上柱國、酂縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋蕭俶為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of Punishments, Huazhou prefect, Pillar of State, Baron of Zan with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Xiao Shu was heir-apparent Guest of Honor at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shu became heir-apparent guest at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 四月，以職方郎中、知制誥裴坦為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Bureau of Appointments Director with edict drafting Pei Tan was Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Tan became Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 以朝議大夫、權知京兆尹崔郢為濮王傅，分司東都，以決殺府吏也；

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Jingzhao prefect Cui Ying was Prince of Pu mentor at the eastern capital — for executing a prefectural clerk;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ying was banished to Luoyang for killing a clerk;

sentences.zh: 以江西觀察使、洪州刺史、御史中丞、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋張毅夫為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Jiangxi observation commissioner, Hongzhou prefect, chief investigating censor with purple-gold fish Zhang Yifu was Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yifu replaced him as Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 以鳳翔節度使、正議大夫、檢校戶部尚書，兼鳳翔尹、上柱國、襲晉國公、食邑三千戶、襲實封一百五十戶裴識可許州刺史，充忠武軍節度、陳許蔡觀察等使；

translations.literal: Fengxiang commissioner, Regular Grand Master, acting Minister of Revenue, concurrent Fengxiang prefect, Pillar of State, Duke of Jin with three thousand households and one hundred fifty fief households Pei Shi was Xuzhou prefect and Zhongwu army commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shi took Xuzhou and Zhongwu;

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎盧懿檢校工部部尚書，兼鳳翔尹、御史大夫、鳳翔隴右節度使；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Lu Yi was acting Minister of Works, concurrent Fengxiang prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Fengxiang-Longyou commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi took Fengxiang;

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人鄭憲為洪州刺史、御史中丞、江南西道都團練觀察處置待使，仍賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Zheng Xian was Hongzhou prefect, chief investigating censor, and Jiangxi West observation commissioner, still granted purple-gold fish.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xian took Jiangxi West.

sentences.zh: 以安南宣慰使、右千牛衛大將軍宋涯為安南都護、御史中丞、本管經略招討處置等使。

translations.literal: Annan consolation commissioner, Right Thousand Bull guard great general Song Ya was Annan Protector, chief investigating censor, and frontier pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ya became Annan Protector.

sentences.zh: 以幽州節度使張允伸弟允中為荊州刺史，允千檀州刺史，允辛安塞軍使，允舉納降軍使，並兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: Youzhou commissioner Zhang Yunshen's younger brothers Yunzhong was Jingzhou prefect, Yunqian Tanzhou, Yunxin Ansa army commander, Yunju Surrender army commander — all concurrent investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunshen's brothers received frontier and circuit posts.

sentences.zh: 以前邠甯節度使、朝議大夫、檢校工部尚書、邠州刺史、上柱國、賜紫金魚柳憙可檢校禮部尚書、河南尹。

translations.literal: Former Binning commissioner, Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Minister of Works, Binzhou prefect, Pillar of State with purple-gold fish Liu Xi was acting Minister of Rites and Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xi took Henan.

sentences.zh: 五月，以職方郎中李玄為壽州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Bureau of Appointments Director Li Xuan was Shouzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xuan became Shouzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月，以朔方靈武定遠等城節度使、朝散大夫、檢校左散騎常侍、靈州大都督府長史、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋劉潼為鄭州刺史，馳驛赴任，以給邊兵糧不及時也。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Shuofang-Lingwu-Dingyuan commissioner, Palace Companion, acting Left Cavalier, Lingzhou metropolitan prefect with purple-gold fish Liu Tong was Zhengzhou prefect — rushed post because border grain was not timely.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tong was rushed to Zhengzhou over late border grain.

sentences.zh: 以安南都護宋涯為容州刺史、容管經略招討處置等使。

translations.literal: Annan Protector Song Ya was Rongzhou prefect and Rongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ya moved to Rongguan.

sentences.zh: 制皇第三男灌封衛王，第十一男澭封廣王。

translations.literal: Invested the third son Guan as Prince of Wei, eleventh son Huang as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Wei and Guang were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 以朝散大夫、守尚書兵部侍郎、判度支、上柱國、彭城縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋蕭鄴本官同平章事、判度支。

translations.literal: Palace Companion, acting Vice Minister of War and finance commissioner, Pillar of State, Baron of Pengcheng with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Xiao Ye was Grand Councillor at his present rank and still finance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ye joined the council while keeping finance.

sentences.zh: 以右監門將軍、知內府省事、清河公崔巨淙為淮南監軍。

translations.literal: Right Palace Gate guard general knowing inner-palace affairs, Duke of Qinghe Cui Juzong was Huainan army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Juzong supervised Huainan troops.

sentences.zh: 以特進、檢校司空、兼太子太傅分司東都、上柱國、扶風郡開國公、食邑二千戶杜忭本官判東都尚書省、兼御史大夫，充東都留守、東畿汝都防禦使。

translations.literal: Special Advance, acting Minister of Education, heir-apparent Grand Tutor at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Duke of Fufeng with two thousand households Du Xian was at present rank acting eastern-capital Ministry of State director, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, eastern capital regent, and eastern capital defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xian oversaw Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 七月，以飛龍使、宮闈局令王歸長守內侍省內常侍，知省事，充內樞密使。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Flying Dragon commissioner and inner-palace bureau director Wang Guichang was acting inner Palace Service director knowing affairs and inner Pivot commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Guichang became inner Pivot commissioner.

sentences.zh: 責授邠州員外司馬張直方為右驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Demoted Binzhou supernumerary registrar Zhang Zhifang was Right Brave Guard great general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhifang was restored as Right Brave Guard general.

sentences.zh: 八月，成德軍節度使、檢校尚書右僕射王紹鼎卒，贈司空，賻布帛三百段。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Chengd commissioner, acting Right Vice Director Wang Shaoding died — posthumously Minister of Works, condolence silk three hundred bolts.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoding died and was posthumously Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以皇子昭王汭為開府儀同三司、守鎮州大都督府長史、成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙觀察等大使；

translations.literal: Prince of Zhao Rui was Palace Companion, acting Zhenzhou metropolitan prefect, Chengd commissioner, and Zhen-Ji-Shen-Zhao observation ambassador;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Rui was named Chengd commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以成德軍節度副使、都知兵馬使、左司馬、知府事、御史中丞王紹懿為成德軍副使留後。

translations.literal: Chengd vice commissioner, overall army commander, Left Army Major knowing affairs, investigating censor Wang Shaoyi was Chengd vice regent.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoyi became Chengd vice regent.

sentences.zh: 以義武軍節度、易定觀察等使、檢校禮部尚書、定州刺史、上柱國、滎陽縣開國男、食邑三百戶鄭涯檢校戶部尚書、汴州刺史、上柱國，充宣武軍節度副大使、知節度事、宋亳觀察、亳州太清宮等使；

translations.literal: Yiwu commissioner, acting Minister of Rites, Dingzhou prefect, Pillar of State, Baron of Xingyang with three hundred households Zheng Ya was acting Minister of Revenue, Bianzhou prefect, Pillar of State, Xuanwu vice commissioner, and Song-Bo observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ya took Bianzhou and Xuanwu;

sentences.zh: 以四鎮北庭行軍、涇原渭武節度使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校右散騎常侍、涇州刺史、御史大夫、上柱國、范陽縣開國男、食邑三百戶盧簡求可檢校工部尚書、定州刺史、義武節度使、易定觀察、北平軍等使；

translations.literal: Four Garrisons-Northern Court, Jingyuan-Longyou commissioner, Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Right Cavalier, Jingzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Baron of Fanyang with three hundred households Lu Jianqiu was acting Minister of Works, Dingzhou prefect, Yiwu commissioner, and Yi-Ding observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianqiu was made acting Minister of Works, Ding prefect, Yiwu commissioner, and Yi-Ding observation commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以鹽州防禦押蕃落諸軍防秋都知兵馬使、度支烏池榷稅使、檢校右散騎常侍、鹽州刺史、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋陸耽代簡求為涇原節度使。

translations.literal: Yanzhou defense commissioner, tribal frontier autumn commander, Wuchi pool tax commissioner, acting Right Cavalier, Yanzhou prefect with purple-gold fish Lu Dan replaced Jianqiu as Jingyuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Dan replaced Lu Jianqiu at Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、朝散大夫、中書舍人、賜紫金魚袋曹確權知河南尹。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician, Palace Companion, Secretariat Drafter with purple-gold fish Cao Que was acting Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Que acted as Henan prefect.

sentences.zh: 汝州防禦使令狐緒有善政，郡人詣闕請立德政碑頌。

translations.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Linghu Xu had good government; the prefecture people went to court requesting a merit stele.
translations.idiomatic: Ruzhou sought a stele for Linghu Xu's good rule.

sentences.zh: 緒以弟綯在中書，上表乞寢，從之。

translations.literal: Xu, because his brother Tao was in the Secretariat, submitted a memorial begging cancellation — assented.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Xu declined the stele while his brother served in council.

sentences.zh: 乙太常卿蘇滌為兵部尚書、權知吏部銓事，以銀青光祿大夫、守散騎常侍、上柱國、渤海郡開國伯、食邑七百戶封敖為太常卿。

translations.literal: Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies Su Mi was Minister of War and acting Personnel selection head; Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Cavalier, Pillar of State, Duke of Bohai with seven hundred households Feng Ao was Grand Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Su Mi and Feng Ao exchanged Ceremonies and War.

sentences.zh: 是月，熒惑犯東井。

translations.literal: That month Mars transgressed the eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed the eastern Well that month.

sentences.zh: 九月，以秦州刺史李承勳為朝散大夫、檢校工部尚書、涇州刺史，充四鎮北庭涇原渭武節度等使；

translations.literal: Ninth month: Qinzhou prefect Li Chengxun was Palace Companion, acting Minister of Works, Jingzhou prefect, and Four Garrisons-Northern Court Jingyuan-Longyou commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengxun took Jingyuan;

sentences.zh: 以禮部郎中楊知溫充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Rites Bureau Director Yang Zhiwen was Hanlin academician;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhiwen entered the Hanlin;

sentences.zh: 以中散大夫、尚書禮部侍郎、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋杜審權為陝州大都督府長史、兼御史大夫、陝虢都防禦觀察處置等使；

translations.literal: General-in-Attendance, Vice Minister of Rites with purple-gold fish Du Shenquan was Shan metropolitan prefect, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Shan-Guo observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Du Shenquan took Shan-Guo;

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫、檢校司空、兼太子太師、上柱國、范陽郡開國公、食邑二千戶盧鈞為檢校司空、同中書門下平章事、興元尹，充山南西道節度等使。

translations.literal: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Minister of Education, heir-apparent Grand Tutor, Pillar of State, Duke of Fanyang with two thousand households Lu Jun was acting Minister of Education, Grand Councillor, Xingyuan prefect, and Shannan West commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jun took Xingyuan and the council.

sentences.zh: 右補闕陳嘏、左拾遺王譜、右拾遺薛傑上疏諫遣中使往羅浮山迎軒轅先生。

translations.literal: Right Reminder Chen Gu, Left Reminder Wang Pu, Right Reminder Xue Jie memorialized against sending palace envoys to Luofu Mountain to welcome Master Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Three remonstrators opposed fetching Xuanyuan Ji from Luofu.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕以萬機事繁，躬親庶務，訪聞羅浮山處士軒轅集，善能攝生，年齡亦壽，乃遣使迎之，或冀有少保理也。

translations.literal: Edict: "We with myriad affairs in profusion personally handle common business; hearing of Luofu recluse Xuanyuan Ji, skilled at nurturing life, age also long — We sent to welcome him, perhaps for slight benefit in ordering."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong said he sought Xuanyuan Ji only for health counsel.

sentences.zh: 朕每觀前史，見秦皇、漢武為方士所惑，常以之為誡。

translations.literal: "We each read former histories and see Qin Shi Huang and Han Wudi deluded by masters of the Way — We take that as warning."
translations.idiomatic: He cited Qin and Han emperors deluded by immortals.

sentences.zh: 卿等位當論列，職在諫司，閱示來章，深納誠意。

translations.literal: "You hold remonstrance posts, received your memorials, deeply accept sincere intent."
translations.idiomatic: He praised the remonstrators' sincerity.

sentences.zh: 」仍謂崔慎由曰：「為吾言於諫官，雖少翁、欒大復生，不能相惑。

translations.literal: " Still tell Cui Shenyou: speak to the remonstrance officials — though Shao Weng and Luan Da were reborn they could not delude Us."
translations.idiomatic: He told Cui Shenyou the immortals could not fool him.

sentences.zh: 如聞軒轅生高士，欲與之一言耳。

translations.literal: "If We hear the high recluse Xuanyuan lives, We wish one word with him — that is all."
translations.idiomatic: He only wanted conversation with the recluse.

sentences.zh: 」宰相鄭朗累月請告，三章求免。

translations.literal: The edict closed with the closing bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 是月乙未，彗出於房初度，長三尺。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Zheng Lang for months requested leave; three memorials begged dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Lang thrice begged leave from office.

sentences.zh: 十月，制通議大夫、守中書侍郎、禮部尚書、同平章事、監修國史、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋鄭朗可檢校尚書右僕射，兼太子少師。

translations.literal: That month on yiwei a comet appeared at the beginning of Fang, three feet long.
translations.idiomatic: A three-foot comet appeared in Fang.

sentences.zh: 以山南西道節度使、中散大夫、檢禮校部尚書、興元尹、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋蔣系權知刑部尚書，宰相崔慎由兼修國史，蕭鄴兼集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Tenth month: General-of-Policy Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Rites, Grand Councillor, dynastic historian with purple-gold fish Zheng Lang was acting Right Vice Director and heir-apparent Junior Preceptor; Shannan West commissioner, General-in-Attendance, acting Minister of Rites, Xingyuan prefect with purple-gold fish Jiang Xi was acting Vice Minister of Punishments; Grand Councillor Cui Shenyou also oversaw dynastic history; Xiao Ye also Hall of Assembled Worthies academician.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Lang retired to Junior Preceptor; posts were reshuffled.

sentences.zh: 以華州刺史高少逸為左散騎常侍，以蘇州刺史裴夷直為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使，乙太常少卿崔鈞為蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: Huazhou prefect Gao Shaoyi was Left Cavalier; Suzhou prefect Pei Yizhi was Huazhou prefect and Tong Pass defense commander; acting Grand Master of Ceremonies Junior Master Cui Jun was Suzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shaoyi, Pei Yizhi, and Cui Jun exchanged Huazhou and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 入回鶻冊禮使、衛尉少卿王端章貶賀州司馬，副使國子《禮記》博士李尋為郴州司馬，判官河南府士曹李寂永州司馬。

translations.literal: Uighur investiture envoy, Court of the Imperial Stud Junior Director Wang Duanzhang was demoted to Hezhou registrar; vice envoy Court of the Heir-apparent Rites Doctor Li Xun to Chenzhou registrar; judge Henan prefecture staff officer Li Ji to Yongzhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Luofu envoys were demoted when the road was blocked.

sentences.zh: 端章等出塞，黑車子阻路而回故也。

translations.literal: Duanzhang and others left the frontier — Black Cart tribes blocked the road and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Black Cart tribes blocked the Uighur mission.

sentences.zh: 以成德軍觀察留後、御史中丞、賜紫金魚袋王紹懿檢校工部尚書，兼鎮州大都督府長史、御史大夫，充成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙觀察等使。

translations.literal: Chengd observation regent, investigating censor with purple-gold fish Wang Shaoyi was acting Minister of Works, concurrent Zhenzhou metropolitan prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Chengd commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoyi became full Chengd commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人李籓權知禮部貢院。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Li Fan was acting Rites examination commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan oversaw the examinations.

sentences.zh: 十一月，太子少師鄭朗卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: heir-apparent Junior Preceptor Zheng Lang died — posthumously Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Lang died and was posthumously Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 銀青光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射、兼太子太保、充右羽林統軍、御史大夫、上柱國、滎陽縣開國男、食邑三百戶鄭光卒，輟朝三日，贈司徒，仍令百官奉慰。

translations.literal: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Left Vice Director, concurrent heir-apparent Grand Protector, Right Feathered Forest commander, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Baron of Xingyang with three hundred households Zheng Guang died — court mourning halted three days, posthumously Minister of Education, still ordering the hundred offices to offer condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Guang died; the court mourned three days.

sentences.zh: 上之元舅也。

translations.literal: He was the emperor's elder maternal uncle.
translations.idiomatic: He was Xuanzong's maternal uncle.

sentences.zh: 宰相崔慎由為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書，尚書蕭鄴兼工部尚書，余並如故。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Cui Shenyou was Vice Director concurrent Minister of Rites; Minister Xiao Ye also Minister of Works — other posts unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shenyou and Xiao Ye picked up extra ministries.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以昭義軍節度使、朝議大夫、檢校工部尚書、上柱國、平陰縣開國男、食邑三百戶畢諴為太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使；

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Zhaoyi commissioner, Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Minister of Works, Pillar of State, Baron of Pingyin with three hundred households Bi Kan was Taiyuan prefect, northern capital regent, and Hedong commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Bi Kan took Hedong;

sentences.zh: 朝議大夫、檢校禮部尚書、兼太原尹、北都留守、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋劉瑑為尚書戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Taiyuan prefect and northern capital regent with purple-gold fish Liu Zuan was Vice Minister of Revenue and finance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zuan took finance in the capital.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、通議大夫、守尚書戶部侍郎、知制誥、上護軍、賜紫金魚袋蔣伸為兵部侍郎，充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician-director, General-of-Policy Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of Revenue with edict drafting and purple-gold fish Jiang Shen was Vice Minister of War, fulfilling duty.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Shen became Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以金紫光祿大夫、守太子少保分司東都、上柱國、河東縣開國男、食邑五百戶裴休檢校戶部尚書兼潞州大都督府長史、昭義軍節度副大使、知節度事、潞磁邢洺觀察等使。

translations.literal: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting heir-apparent Grand Protector at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Viscount of Hedong with five hundred households Pei Xiu was acting Minister of Revenue, concurrent Lu metropolitan prefect, Zhaoyi vice commissioner, and Lu-Ci-Xing observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xiu took Zhaoyi from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 以正議大夫、行尚書兵部侍郎、上柱國、河東縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋柳仲郢本官兼御史大夫，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of War, Pillar of State, Viscount of Hedong with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Liu Zhongye was at present rank also Censor-in-Chief and salt-and-transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhongye took the salt monopoly.

sentences.zh: 以正議大夫、檢校戶部尚書、兼太子賓客、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋孔溫業本官分司東都，以病請告故也。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting Minister of Revenue, concurrent heir-apparent Guest of Honor with purple-gold fish Kong Wenye was at present rank assigned eastern capital — for illness requesting leave.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Wenye went to Luoyang on sick leave.

sentences.zh: 禮部郎中楊右溫本官知制誥，充翰林學士。

translations.literal: Rites Bureau Director Yang Youwen was at present rank edict drafter and Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Youwen entered the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 以幽州中軍使、檢校國子祭酒、幽府左司馬、知府事、御史中丞張簡真檢校右散騎常侍，允伸之子也。

translations.literal: Youzhou central army commander, acting Director of Education, Youzhou Left Army Major knowing affairs, investigating censor Zhang Jianzhen was acting Right Cavalier — son of Yunshen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jianzhen, Yunshen's son, rose in Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 以中散大夫、權知刑部尚書、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋蔣系檢校戶部尚書、鳳翔尹、御史大夫、鳳翔隴右節度觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: General-in-Attendance, acting Vice Minister of Punishments with purple-gold fish Jiang Xi was acting Minister of Revenue, Fengxiang prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Fengxiang-Longyou observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Xi took Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，舒州吳塘堰有眾禽成巢，闊七尺，高七丈，而水禽、山鳥、鷹隼、燕雀之類，無不馴狎。

translations.literal: That year at Wutang weir in Shuzhou many birds nested together, seven feet wide, seven zhang high — water birds, mountain birds, hawks, swallows — all tame.
translations.idiomatic: A vast mixed bird nest appeared at Shuzhou's Wutang weir.

sentences.zh: 又有鳥人面緣毛，爪喙皆紺色，其聲曰「甘」，人呼為「甘蟲」。

translations.literal: Also a bird with human face and green fur, claws and beak all indigo, its cry "sweet" — people called it "sweet insect."
translations.idiomatic: A human-faced "sweet insect" bird appeared.

sentences.zh: 大中十二年十二年春正月，以晉陽令鄭液為通州刺史。

translations.literal: Dazhong 12, spring, first month: Jinyang magistrate Zheng Ye was Tongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ye became Tongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 羅浮山人軒轅集至京師，上召入禁中，謂曰：「先生遐壽而長生可致乎？

translations.literal: Luofu Mountain man Xuanyuan Ji reached the capital; the Emperor summoned him to the inner palace and said: "Master, remote age and long life — can longevity be attained?"
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong asked Xuanyuan Ji whether immortality was possible.

sentences.zh: 」曰：「徹聲色，去滋味，哀樂如一，德施周給，自然與天地合德，日月齊明，何必別求長生也。

translations.literal: "He said: "Banish sound and color, remove flavors, make joy and sorrow one, virtue extending thoroughly — naturally join Heaven and Earth in virtue, sun and moon in brightness; why seek longevity separately?"
translations.idiomatic: Ji said virtue, not tricks, aligned one with heaven.

sentences.zh: 」留之月餘，堅求還山。

translations.literal: " Detained over a month, he firmly begged to return to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Ji stayed a month then insisted on leaving.

sentences.zh: 以前鄉貢進士于琮為秘書省校書郎，尋尚皇女廣德公主，改銀青光祿大夫、守右拾遺、駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Former provincial degree graduate Yu Cong was Secretariat proofreader; soon married Princess Guangde — changed to Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Right Reminder, Commandant-consort.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Cong married Princess Guangde and became commandant-consort.

sentences.zh: 以安南本管經略招討處置使、朝散大夫、檢校左散騎常侍、安南都護、御史大夫、賜紫金魚袋李弘甫為宗正卿。

translations.literal: Annan frontier pacification commissioner, Palace Companion, acting Left Cavalier, Annan Protector, Censor-in-Chief with purple-gold fish Li Hongfu was Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongfu became Director of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 以中大夫、守京兆尹、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋張毅夫為鄂州刺史、御史大夫、鄂岳蘄黃申等州都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Palace, acting Jingzhao prefect with purple-gold fish Zhang Yifu was Ezhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and E-Yue-Qi-Huang-Shen observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yifu took Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 乙太中大夫、福州刺史、御史中丞、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋楊發檢校右散騎常侍、廣州刺史、御史大夫，充嶺南東道節度觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Acting Grand Master of the Palace, Fuzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief with purple-gold fish Yang Fa was acting Right Cavalier, Guangzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Lingnan East observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fa took Lingnan East.

sentences.zh: 以朝散大夫、守康王傅分司東都、上柱國、襲魏郡開國公、食邑二千戶、賜紫金魚袋王式為安南都護、兼御史中丞，充安南本管經略招討處置等使。

translations.literal: Palace Companion, acting Prince of Kang mentor at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Duke of Wei with two thousand households and purple-gold fish Wang Shi was Annan Protector, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Annan frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shi took Annan.

sentences.zh: 以朝請大夫、前守太了賓客分司東都、上柱國、酂縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋蕭俶守太子少保分司。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, former acting heir-apparent Guest of Honor at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Baron of Zan with three hundred households and purple-gold fish Xiao Shu was acting heir-apparent Grand Protector at eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shu became Luoyang grand protector.

sentences.zh: 以朝請大夫、檢校左散騎常侍、右金吾將軍、充右街使、上柱國、襲太原郡開國公、食邑二千戶、賜紫金魚袋王鎮為檢校左散騎常侍、使持節都督福州諸軍事，福州刺史、御史大夫，充福建等州都團練觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting Left Cavalier, Right Gold Crow general, Right Street commissioner, Pillar of State, Duke of Taiyuan with two thousand households Wang Zhen was acting Left Cavalier, holding staff as Fuzhou military commissioner, Fuzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Fujian observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen was made acting Left Cavalier, Fuzhou military commissioner, Fuzhou prefect, censor-in-chief, and Fujian observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、朝議郎、守尚書司勳郎中、知制誥、賜緋魚袋孔溫裕為中書舍人，充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician, Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Bureau of Merit Director with edict drafting and scarlet fish Kong Wenyu was Secretariat Drafter, fulfilling duty.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Wenyu became Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 以右驍衛上將軍李正源守大內皇城留守。

translations.literal: Right Brave Guard senior general Li Zhengyuan was inner Bright City regent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhengyuan guarded the inner city.

sentences.zh: 以朝議大夫、守尚書戶部侍郎、判度支、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋劉瑑本官同平章事，依前判度支。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Vice Minister of Revenue and finance commissioner with purple-gold fish Liu Zuan was Grand Councillor at his present rank, still finance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zuan joined the council while keeping finance.

sentences.zh: 乙太中大夫、守中書侍郎、兼禮部尚書、同平章事、監修國史、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋崔慎由檢校禮部尚書、梓州刺史、御史大夫、劍南東川節度副大使、知節度事，代韋有翼；

translations.literal: Acting Grand Master of the Palace, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, Grand Councillor, dynastic historian with purple-gold fish Cui Shenyou was acting Minister of Rites, Zizhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief, Sword South East Chuan vice commissioner, replacing Wei Youyi;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shenyou went to East Chuan;

sentences.zh: 以有翼為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Youyi was Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Youyi took Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月，以前邕管經略招討處置使、朝議郎、邕州刺史、御史中丞、賜紫金魚袋段文楚為昭武校尉、右金吾衛將軍；

translations.literal: Second month: former Yongguan pacification commissioner, Court Gentleman for Discussion, Yongzhou prefect, Censor-in-Chief with purple-gold fish Duan Wenchu was Zhaowu Commandant and Right Gold Crow guard general;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Wenchu entered the guard;

sentences.zh: 以朝議郎、守中書舍人、權知禮部貢舉、上柱國、賜緋魚袋李籓為尚書戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Secretariat Drafter, acting Rites examination commissioner with scarlet fish Li Fan was Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以朝散大夫、守工部尚書、同平章事、充集賢殿大學士、上柱國、彭城縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋蕭鄴為監修國史。

translations.literal: Palace Companion, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councillor, Hall of Assembled Worthies academician with purple-gold fish Xiao Ye was dynastic historian.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ye oversaw the Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 以朝議大夫、守戶部侍郎、同平章事、判度支、主柱國、賜紫金魚袋劉瑑可充集賢院學士。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Vice Minister of Revenue, Grand Councillor, finance commissioner, Pillar of State with purple-gold fish Liu Zuan might be Hall of Assembled Worthies academician.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zuan also joined the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 以渤海國王弟權知國務大虔晃為銀青光祿大夫、檢校秘書監、忽汗州都督，冊為渤海國王。

translations.literal: Balhae king's younger brother acting state affairs Da Qianhuang was Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Palace Library Director, Hohan prefectural governor, and invested king of Balhae.
translations.idiomatic: Balhae invested Da Qianhuang as king.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎柳仲郢為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Liu Zhongye was Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhongye took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 以朝議大夫、守尚書戶部侍郎、判戶部事、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋夏侯孜為兵部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使；

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Vice Minister of Revenue and revenue head with purple-gold fish Xiahou Zi was Vice Minister of War and salt-and-transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Xiahou Zi took the salt monopoly;

sentences.zh: 以朝請大夫、權知刑部侍郎、賜紫金魚袋杜勝為戶部侍郎、判戶部事。

translations.literal: Regular Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of Punishments with purple-gold fish Du Sheng was Vice Minister of Revenue and revenue head.
translations.idiomatic: Du Sheng took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 光祿大夫、守左領軍衛大將軍分司東都、上柱國、會稽縣開國公、食邑一千五百戶康季榮可檢校尚書右僕射，兼右衛上將軍分司。

translations.literal: Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Left Leading Guard great general at eastern capital, Pillar of State, Duke of Kuaiji with fifteen hundred households Kang Jirong was acting Right Vice Director and Right Guard senior general at eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Jirong was honored at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 貶前利州刺史杜倉為賀州司戶，蔡州刺史李叢邵州司馬。

translations.literal: Demoted former Lizhou prefect Du Cang to Hezhou registrar; Caizhou prefect Li Cong to Shaozhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Du Cang and Li Cong were demoted.

sentences.zh: 以工部郎中、知制誥于德孫，庫部郎中、知制誥苗恪，並可中書舍人，依前翰林學士。

translations.literal: Bureau of Works Director with edict drafting Yu Desun and Bureau of Stores Director with edict drafting Miao Ke were both Secretariat drafters, still Hanlin academicians.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Desun and Miao Ke became drafters.

sentences.zh: 以前右金吾衛將軍鄭漢璋，前鴻臚少卿鄭漢卿，並起復授本官，國舅光之子也。

translations.literal: Former Right Gold Crow guard general Zheng Hanzhang and former Court of the Imperial Stud Junior Director Zheng Hanqing were both restored to former posts — sons of the late maternal uncle Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hanzhang and Hanqing, sons of Zheng Guang, were restored.

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫、行給事中、駙馬都尉衛洙為工部侍郎，前濮王傅分司皇甫權為康王傅分司。

translations.literal: Silver-glitter Grand Master, acting Remonstrance official, Commandant-consort Wei Zhu was Vice Minister of Works; former Prince of Pu mentor at eastern capital Huangfu Quan was Prince of Kang mentor at eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhu and Huangfu Quan exchanged mentor posts.

sentences.zh: 以庫部員外郎、史館修撰李渙為長安令。

translations.literal: Stores Bureau outer-section member and History Office compiler Li Huan was Chang'an magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan became Chang'an magistrate.

sentences.zh: 閏二月，以司農少卿盧籍為代州刺史，前江陵少尹杜惲為司農少卿。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month: Minister of Agriculture Junior Director Lu Ji was Daizhou prefect; former Jiangling Junior Vice Prefect Du Yin was Minister of Agriculture Junior Director.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Ji and Du Yin exchanged agriculture posts.

sentences.zh: 以河東馬步都虞候段威為朔州刺史，充天寧軍使，兼興唐軍沙陀三部落防遏都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Hedong horse-and-foot chief inspector Duan Wei was Shuofang prefect, Tianning army commander, and commander of the three Shatuo tribes of Xingtang with frontier defense duties.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Wei took Shuofang and Shatuo defense.

sentences.zh: 五月，以兵部侍郎、鹽鐵轉運使夏侯孜本官同平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Vice Minister of War and salt commissioner Xiahou Zi was Grand Councillor at his present rank.
translations.idiomatic: Xiahou Zi joined the council.

sentences.zh: 六月，南蠻攻安南府。

translations.literal: Sixth month: southern barbarians attacked Annan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Southern tribes attacked Annan.

sentences.zh: 八月，洪州賊毛合、宣州賊康全大攻掠郡縣，詔兩浙兵討平之。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Hongzhou bandit Mao He and Xuanzhou bandit Kang Quanda raided prefectures and counties — edict ordered Liang-Zhe troops to suppress and pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Mao He and Kang Quanda were suppressed by Zhe troops.

sentences.zh: 十二月，太子少保魏掞卒，贈司徒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: heir-apparent Grand Protector Wei Zhan died — posthumously Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhan died and was posthumously Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 大中十三年十三年春正月，以虢陝觀察使杜審權為戶部侍郎、判戶部事。

translations.literal: Dazhong 13, first month: Shaan-Guo observation commissioner Du Shenquan was made Vice Minister of Revenue and acting revenue commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong 13's first month Du Shenquan took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三月，宰相蕭鄴罷知政事，守吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month: Grand Councillor Xiao Ye left council affairs and kept the post of Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Xiao Ye left the council but kept Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四月，以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎、知制誥蔣伸本官同平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Hanlin academician-director, Vice Minister of War, edict drafter Jiang Shen was made Grand Councillor at his present rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Jiang Shen joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 五月，上不豫，月餘不能視朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Emperor was unwell; for more than a month he could not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xuanzong fell ill and skipped court for over a month.

sentences.zh: 八月七日，宣遺詔立鄆王為皇太子，勾當軍國事。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the eighth month the testamentary edict installed Prince of Yun as heir apparent to manage state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's seventh day Prince of Yun was made heir and regent.

sentences.zh: 是日，崩于大明宮，聖壽五十。

translations.literal: That day he died at Daming Palace; sacred longevity fifty.
translations.idiomatic: That day Xuanzong died at Daming Palace at fifty.

sentences.zh: 詔門下侍郎、平章事令狐綯攝塚宰。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor Linghu Tao to act as chief mourner.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Tao was ordered to oversee the funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 群臣上諡曰聖武獻文孝皇帝，廟號宣宗。

translations.literal: The ministers gave the posthumous title Sacred Martial Literary Filial Emperor; temple name Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: The court named him Xuanzong, posthumous title Sacred Martial Literary Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月，葬於貞陵。

translations.literal: Second month of year 14: buried at Zhen Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year's second month he was buried at Zhen Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 【論】史臣曰：臣嘗聞黎老言大中故事，獻文皇帝器識深遠，久曆艱難，備知人間疾苦。

translations.literal: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian says: I have heard elders speak of Dazhong times — the Literary Filial Emperor's capacity and insight were far-reaching; long tested by hardship, he fully knew the people's suffering.
translations.idiomatic: 【Historian's appraisal】 Elders recalled Dazhong: Xuanzong's insight ran deep and hardship had taught him the people's pain.

sentences.zh: 自寶曆巳來，中人擅權，事多假借，京師豪右，大擾窮民。

translations.literal: From Baoli onward eunuchs usurped power; affairs were often done in their name; capital magnates greatly harassed the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Since Baoli eunuchs and capital bullies had preyed on commoners.

sentences.zh: 洎大中臨馭，一之日權豪斂跡，二之日奸臣畏法，三之日閽寺讋氣。

translations.literal: When Dazhong came to rule: on the first day powerful families shrank back; on the second day wicked ministers feared the law; on the third day palace eunuchs trembled.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuanzong magnates shrank, corrupt ministers feared law, and eunuchs quailed.

sentences.zh: 由是刑政不濫，賢能效用，百揆四岳，穆若清風，十餘年間，頌聲載路。

translations.literal: Hence punishments were not excessive, the worthy served effectively, the hundred offices and four peaks were calm as a clear breeze; for more than ten years praise filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Justice held, talent served, and for a decade praise filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 上宮中衣浣濯之衣，常膳不過數器，非母后侑膳，輒不舉樂，歲或小饑，憂形於色。

translations.literal: In the palace he wore washed clothes; regular meals were no more than a few vessels; unless the empress dowager shared the meal, music was not raised; in years of slight famine worry showed on his face.
translations.idiomatic: He wore washed palace robes, ate frugally, shunned music except at the empress dowager's table, and showed famine on his face.

sentences.zh: 雖左右近習，未嘗見怠惰之容。

translations.literal: Even close attendants never saw a lazy countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Even intimates never saw idleness in him.

sentences.zh: 與群臣言，儼然煦接，如待賓僚，或有所陳聞，虛襟聽納。

translations.literal: Speaking with ministers, he was solemn yet warm as if receiving guests; when they offered remonstrance he listened with an open breast.
translations.idiomatic: With ministers he was solemn yet welcoming and heard remonstrance openly.

sentences.zh: 舊時人主所行，黃門先以龍腦、郁金藉地，上悉命去之。

translations.literal: Formerly when emperors walked, eunuchs first spread borneol and turmeric on the ground — he ordered all that removed.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the eunuchs' custom of perfuming the ground before him.

sentences.zh: 宮人有疾，醫視之，既瘳，即袖金賜之，誡曰：「勿令敕使知，謂予私于侍者。

translations.literal: When palace women fell ill and physicians cured them, he would slip gold into his sleeve to reward them, admonishing: "Do not let edict envoys know — lest they think I favor attendants privately."
translations.idiomatic: He secretly rewarded physicians who cured palace women, lest envoys think he played favorites.

sentences.zh: 」其恭儉好善如此。

translations.literal: Such was his respectful thrift and love of goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his frugal, good-hearted rule.

sentences.zh: 季年風毒，召羅浮山人軒轅集，訪以治國治身之要，其伎術詭異之道，未嘗措言。

translations.literal: In his late years wind toxins afflicted him; he summoned the Luofu Mountain man Xuanyuan Ji and asked essentials of ordering state and self; of freak arts and deceitful ways he never spoke.
translations.idiomatic: Late in life he summoned Xuanyuan Ji of Luofu for statecraft and self-cultivation, never for occult tricks.

sentences.zh: 集亦有道之士也。

translations.literal: Ji too was a man of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Ji himself was a man of the Way.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，堅求還山。

translations.literal: In the spring of year 13 he firmly begged to return to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong 13's spring Ji begged to return to the mountains.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「先生少留一年，候于羅浮山別創一道館。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Master, stay one more year — We shall build a separate lodge for you on Luofu Mountain."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong asked him to stay a year while a Luofu lodge was built.

sentences.zh: 」集無留意，上曰：「先生舍我亟去，國有災乎？

translations.literal: Ji had no mind to linger; the Emperor said: "Master leaves Us so quickly — does the state have disaster?
translations.idiomatic: When Ji would not stay, Xuanzong asked whether disaster followed his departure.

sentences.zh: 朕有天下，竟得幾年？

translations.literal: We hold all under Heaven — how many years may We have?"
translations.idiomatic: "How many years remain to my reign?" he asked.

sentences.zh: 」集取筆寫「四十」字，而十字挑上，乃十四年也。

translations.literal: Ji took a brush and wrote the character "forty"; crossing out the middle ten strokes left fourteen — thus fourteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Ji wrote "forty" and crossed the middle stroke — fourteen years remained.

sentences.zh: 興替有數，其若是乎！

translations.literal: Rise and fall have their number — was it not so!
translations.idiomatic: Dynastic fortune had its numbered span.

sentences.zh: 而帝道皇猷，始終無缺，雖漢文、景不足過也。

translations.literal: Yet the imperial Way and royal plan from start to finish had no flaw; even Han Wendi and Jingdi do not surpass it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his reign from first to last had no flaw — even Han Wen and Jing pale beside it.

sentences.zh: 惜乎簡藉遺落，舊事十無三四，吮墨揮翰，有所慊然。

translations.literal: Alas that brief records are lost — old affairs are three or four in ten; sucking ink and wielding the brush, one still feels regret.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, records are lost and the historian can recover only scraps.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：李之英主，實惟獻文。

translations.literal: 【Eulogy】 The brilliant lord of Li — truly the Literary Filial One.
translations.idiomatic: 【Eulogy】 Tang's brilliant lord was the Literary Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 粃粺盡去，淑慝斯分。

translations.literal: Chaff and poison are wholly swept away; the good and wicked are sorted apart.
translations.idiomatic: Chaff and poison were swept away; good and wicked were sorted.

sentences.zh: 河、隴歸地，朔漠消氛。

translations.literal: He and Long returned to the realm; the northern deserts lost their miasma.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi returned and the northern frontier cleared.

sentences.zh: 到今遺老，歌詠明君。

translations.literal: To this day old folk sing of the enlightened ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Old folk still sing of the enlightened ruler.
